title: OpenTelemetry Specification 1.59.0
relevance: Normative umbrella specification for the OpenTelemetry API, SDK and data contracts. It distinguishes requirements expressed with BCP 14 keywords from explanatory guidance and anchors the API-versus-SDK boundary used in the lesson. Version 1.59.0 is a snapshot: individual signals, sections and language implementations can have different maturity and release versions, so this record does not turn every OpenTelemetry feature into a stable or implemented capability.
